_why: Which prerendered pages build-cf.mjs copies into .open-next/assets so Cloudflare answers them WITHOUT starting the Worker. The OpenNext Worker imports its 45 MB server bundle on the first request of every cold isolate (measured ~0.9 s CPU; the free plan allows 10 ms), so any request that reaches the Worker can fail with error 1102; a file in assets costs ~3 ms and no Worker invocation. scripts/static-pages-to-assets.mjs DISCOVERS the routes from .next/prerender-manifest.json: every fully static route (initialRevalidateSeconds === false) is copied unless it is excluded below, plus ISR routes under isrStaticPrefixes. Trade-offs of bypassing the Worker (see docs/runbooks/cloudflare-web-deploy.md): middleware.ts does not run (no portal 307 for signed-out visitors, no poojly_language cookie, no ?lang= handling, no Content-Language header), the asset layer ignores query strings and request headers, and a client-side soft navigation to these paths falls back to a full page load (the RSC request is answered with HTML).

mustBeStatic._why: Build FAILS if any of these routes is missing from the prerender output or is not fully static. portalPrefixes must list every PORTAL_PREFIXES entry of middleware.ts (a test pins that): every page route under them must be fully static, or be listed in workerServed with its reason.

workerServed._why: Page routes under portalPrefixes that legitimately stay on the Worker (dynamic [param] segments or server-rendered). Anything else under a portal prefix that stops being static fails the build.
workerServed./admin/users/[id]: dynamic segment, no generateStaticParams; /admin/users/view is the static twin
workerServed./priest/bookings/[id]: dynamic segment; /priest/bookings/view is the static twin

exclude._why: Static routes that MUST reach the Worker. Everything else static is copied.

routes./hi: locale landing: middleware stores poojly_language on it
routes./ta: locale landing: middleware stores poojly_language on it
routes./te: locale landing: middleware stores poojly_language on it
routes./bn: locale landing: middleware stores poojly_language on it
routes./mr: locale landing: middleware stores poojly_language on it

prefixes./help/articles/: per-language articles: Content-Language must follow the path locale
prefixes./static-shell/: internal rewrite targets of middleware (/pujas, /store); never a public URL

isrStaticPrefixes._why: Sections that are ISR only because of `export const revalidate` but render committed in-repo data (no fetch, no cookies, no dates; verified by __tests__/cf-static-assets.test.ts). The Workers incremental cache is read-only, so these never refresh between deploys anyway; copying them only removes the cold-Worker hit. Live-data sections (temples, pujas, panchang, blog, store, wellness, astrology, city, yatra-packages, deity, festival, calendar, help, content ISR) are deliberately NOT here.
